video_title: Scoot Henderson Media Availability | Oct. 1, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on team goals for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: finish higher and less turnovers rate that we had last year
quotes.quote: Specifically is finish higher and less turnovers rate that we had last year. Rebounding the ball defensively, I feel like we are very solid crashing. Offensively team, but defensively rebound the ball more, take care of the ball more, and make sure when you hit the open guy, give a great pass.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson says the Blazers' main goals for this season are to finish higher in the standings and cut down on turnovers. He emphasized the need to be more solid defensively and take better care of the ball.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on chemistry with teammate Josh Hart
quotes.excerpt: He finds the open guy, plays the right way, skilled as y'all all know
quotes.quote: It's fun. Very fun. I think we played alongside each other a few times, not this training camp but the week before or so we've been here for a few minutes. Pick up, so it's really fun. He finds the open guy, plays the right way, skilled as y'all all know, off the ball or on the ball. Both. Just kind of interchangeable. He's a great teammate, all-around teammate, always cheering whoever has it on.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson on playing with Josh Hart: It is really fun. He finds the open guy and plays the right way. We are interchangeable on and off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the competitive spirit of Charles Bassey
quotes.excerpt: Knowing him personally more, it's high spirit, high spirit
quotes.quote: High spirit. I feel like from the outside looking, I'm just as I'm just with y'all. I'm seeing what I can observe. Then knowing him personally more, it's high spirit, high spirit. Seems like he likes it here in the city of Portland. I'm going to let him give y'all his feel, but from the outside looking in, great dude. Love playing with him, love being guard-to-guard with him, love guarding him at practice, and I feel like we're going to interior this this season.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson on Charles Bassey: He has high spirit and seems to like it here in Portland. I love playing with him and love being guard to guard with him.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on Dylan Harper's comments regarding his defense
quotes.excerpt: Dylan is great, great aspiring guard because I'm also that
quotes.quote: Dylan is great, great aspiring guard because I'm also that, but great rookie season as y'all all know of, and I feel like he's going to have a great career as well. It's just competitive spirit. Dylan is great, great, I don't even want to say young aspiring guard because I'm also that, but great rookie season as y'all all know of, and I feel like he's going to have a great career as well. It's just competitive spirit.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson on Dylan Harper: He is a great aspiring guard who had a great rookie season. I feel like he is going to have a great career.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the importance of the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: I feel like as a team we have a lot online, I feel like we can win
quotes.quote: I feel like this season is going to be very important. I feel like as a team we have a lot online, I feel like we can win. That's my biggest thing. I feel like we can win and anything other than that, I'm going to feel a little crush myself if we don't go on that right path that I think we can go on, and I think we can reach our highest potential as long as we just stick together.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson says this season is very important for the Blazers. I feel like we can win and I am going to feel a little crush myself if we do not go on that right path.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on team focus and Coach Chauncey Billups' leadership
quotes.excerpt: Coach Chauncey is huge on that and that's what's going to make us better
quotes.quote: Today was another focused day and a day we needed as a team. Wasn't an effort thing, as anybody in the league knows, we're never going to lack of effort. More of a focus, paying attention to the small details, and Coach Chauncey is huge on that and that's what's going to make us better. I feel like he's a great leader and as long as we listen to him, pay attention to the small things that make us better, the vets are also on us as well.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson says the team is focusing on small details under Chauncey Billups. He called Billups a great leader and noted that the vets are also keeping the team accountable.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the coaching style of Michael Nored
quotes.excerpt: I like Michael Nored's coaching style, he get in your ear, you know what I'm saying
quotes.quote: I like Michael Nored's coaching style, he get in your ear, you know what I'm saying, then also cheer you up. We don't need anybody sugarcoating, especially the team we have, we can't have any sugarcoating and leaning in type of guy in charge at this point. I feel like we need a guy that's Michael Nored.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson on coach Michael Nored: We do not need anybody sugarcoating. I feel like we need a guy that is Michael Nored.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on handling contract negotiations
quotes.excerpt: I play my best basketball, that's how I go on about that
quotes.quote: I play my best basketball, that's how I go on about that. I play my best basketball at practice, when the game time comes, I show my best hand. That's all you can do. At that point you don't try to negotiate yourself. I feel like I leave that up to the people that have those jobs and I play my best basketball at hand.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson on contract negotiations: I play my best basketball and leave that up to the people that have those jobs.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the energy of the 2026 roster
quotes.excerpt: I want the Portland Trail Blazers fans to understand that we got a lot of high energy
quotes.quote: I want the Portland Trail Blazers fans to understand that we got a lot of high energy just coming into the season. I know it's easy thing to do coming into the season, but I feel like there's something that this is something that we can kind of sustain throughout, through the ups and downs. As y'all know, Rip City is one of the most loyal fan bases out there and it's all going to pay off.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson wants Blazers fans to know the team has a lot of high energy coming into the season and believes it is something they can sustain through the ups and downs.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the performance of Maggie
quotes.excerpt: Amazing, after everything she picked up everybody's slack, my slack, everybody's
quotes.quote: Amazing, after everything she picked up everybody's slack, my slack, everybody's. Maggie is always great, love Maggie.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson on Maggie: She is always great and picked up everybody's slack.
